paper: Seeing the Whole Elephant: A Benchmark for Failure Attribution in LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems (ACL 2026)

layout.description: One directory per failed execution (220 total). Each holds the full observable trace (step_records.json), the expert annotation (trace_metadata.json), and browser screenshots for Magentic-One runs (images/).

trace_metadata.json.task_instruction: str — the task prompt given to the agent system
trace_metadata.json.run_id: str — equals task_id in released data
trace_metadata.json.mistake_step: str of int — expert-annotated decisive failure step (when), 1-indexed into step_records
trace_metadata.json.mistake_reason: str — expert-written reason for the attribution
trace_metadata.json.tests_status: dict FAIL_TO_PASS/PASS_TO_PASS -> success/failure test lists (swe-agent only)
trace_metadata.json.ground_truth: str — expected answer (magentic/captain tasks; absent for swe-agent)
trace_metadata.json.agent_system_intro: str — markdown description of the agent system

step_records.json.type: list of step objects, in execution order

step.agent_name: str — e.g. Orchestrator, WebSurfer, str_replace_editor, bash, submit, DataVerification_Expert

input.messages: list — OpenAI chat messages; image parts are {"type":"image","image_file":"images/step_N_image_1.png"}

step.output: dict — OpenAI ChatCompletion object (id, model, created, object, usage, choices[])
step.tool_logs: list of tool-call records or null

schema.images/step_<N>_image_1.png: browser screenshot referenced by step N input messages (magentic runs)
